item.tib: mkha' 'gro grib sel gyi byang bu
item.coloph: bdag 'dra rig 'dzin kun grol gsang ba rtsal gyi thugs rje (rjes) dkon phug rin chen brag gi them bar nas spyan drangs pa'i shog ser dang / gyer spungs yab yum gyi zhal gdam bka' gter ma bu kha sbyor du bzhugs pa las ldan spa yi gdung las bskyed pa'i rong bsgom tshe dbang 'od zer gyis bskul ba la brten te/ mkhas bzhi'i sgrub gnas su gtan la dbab (phab) ste/ yi ge pa ni tshe dbang rgyalamatshan gyis bgyis pas bstan 'gro'i phan bde'i rgyu ru gyur cig/
